pages.title: Two syringe uses
pages.text: Both use $(bold)left-click attack$(), but the event is cancelled: the animal takes no damage and is not knocked back.$(br2)$(li)$(bold)Empty syringe$(): draw genetic fluid from an animal; the tube records its species.$(br)$(li)$(bold)Filled syringe$(): inject another animal whose stats qualify, making it pregnant.

pages.title: Requirements and result
pages.text: Conception requires all four stats $(bold)≥ 7$() (satiety, thirst, cleanliness, mood). Success applies a $(bold)8-minute$() pregnancy buff.$(br2)On expiry, the mother's four stats are zeroed and $(bold)3~5$() babies spawn at her position — the species comes from the genetic fluid, not the mother. Inject a pig with cow fluid and it gives birth to calves.

pages.title: Tunable only in code
pages.text: These constants live in $(thing)SyringeHandler$() and $(thing)PregnancyHandler$():$(br2)$(li)$(thing)PREGNANCY_TICKS$() = 8×60×20$(br)$(li)$(thing)CONDITION_LINE$() = 7$(br)$(li)$(thing)MIN_BABIES$() / $(thing)MAX_BABIES$() = 3 / 5$(br2)Changing them requires editing the source and recompiling; neither config nor data packs can reach them.
